CAI5735 Group 1 Mid-Term Project

Karissa Kocourek, James Jobczynski, and Cameron Wilson

This Marimo notebook will serve as our mid-term project collaboration, and is comprised of an executable Marimo notebook and presentation slides. Project Directions: Available HERE. Project submission due: October 15, 2026 at 23:59

Research Question:

How is antibiotic resistance related to country income group and does it vary by antibiotic class?
Load the target dataset through pandas' read_csv, and inspect the data to show basic descriptors such as head/tail, shape, length, etc.
